title: Wink MCS-51 chip manifest
description: Stage6 S6-2 (PLAN-20260911-MCS51-S6, CPL-16): the single fact source for MCS-51 chip-family header facts, memory limits and SDCC gate rules. Filename stem MUST equal the `family` key (total §3.1c); the manifest is the only place a toolchain script learns family facts. Exactly five top-level groups — do not add a sixth.

family.description: Family key = manifest filename stem = chips/<family>/ directory name.

aliases.description: MCU alias names accepted by the build/toolchain selection (e.g. stc89c52 -> at89c52).

vendor_include_dir.description: Chip-package include directory holding the family's vendor headers (repo-relative).

allow_regex.description: Header-name regexes that may legitimately exist in vendor/chip scope (lint header facts).

forbid_in_core_regex.description: Regexes that must never appear in generic core files (layering residue gate). Inline (?i) is honoured.

cleanup_alias_regex.description: Additional Keil device-header name patterns the cleanup pass normalizes to <wink_mcu.h>, on top of the standard reg51/reg52/regx52 set.

xram_bytes.description: On-chip XRAM size in bytes; null when the part has none (external MOVX aperture, board-scoped).

xsfr_window.description: Extended-SFR MOVX window as [base, size]; null when the family has no such window.

vendor_device_header.description: Repo-relative vendor device header path transpiled for the SDCC gate; null when none.

vendor_stddriver_dir.description: Repo-relative vendor StdDriver directory compiled+linked by the SDCC gate; null when none.

stddriver_link.description: Named vendor StdDriver link units the gate links (empty for pure-core families).
